relationship_changes.subject: Nancy Hamilton (Hamilton-44032)
relationship_changes.explanation: The original 1851 Ballycraigargh census living return calls Nancy James Glasgow's unmarried sister-in-law; Peggy is James's wife. The paired mortality return calls Robert and Cathrin Hamilton James's father-in-law and mother-in-law. Nancy is therefore Peggy's sister and a daughter of Robert and Cathrin.
previous_status_provenance: research/Hamilton-44032/findings.md:1-5 (new direct relationship finding; no earlier sourced relationship recorded)
research/Hamilton-25516/findings.md:5-16 (19 August 2026 assessment distinguishes the newly evidenced sibling/parent links from Peggy's still-uncertain maternity links)
source_citations: 1851 Census of Ireland, Dunaghy parish, Ballycraigargh household 29, living return, image 251
